title: Great and Mighty King
lyrics_original: The cross delivered all our hearts from fear
You came to make a way
Jesus you came to raise the dead to life
We bow with heaven and sing
What do we have to bring
This is our offering, our hearts before
Jesus the one who saves, be lifted high
We bow with heaven and sing
We bow with heaven and sing
author_english: Christopher Joel Brown, Brett Younker, Zachary Kale

bible_verses.telugu: ఆయన మనలను  అంధకారసంబంధమైన  అధికారములోనుండి విడుదలచేసి, తాను ప్రేమించిన తన కుమారునియొక్క రాజ్యనివాసులనుగా చేసెను. ఆ కుమారునియందు మనకు విమోచనము, అనగా పాపక్షమాపణ కలుగుచున్నది.
bible_verses.english: For he has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of the Son he loves, in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా రాజ్యము చేయుచున్నాడు ప్రభావమును ఆయన వస్త్రముగా ధరించియున్నాడు యెహోవా బలముధరించి బలముతో నడుము కట్టు కొనియున్నాడు కదలకుండునట్లు భూలోకము స్థిరపరచబడియున్నది.
bible_verses.english: The Lord reigns, he is robed in majesty; the Lord is robed in majesty and armed with strength; indeed, the world is established, firm and secure.

bible_verses.telugu: అయినను దేవుడు కరుణాసంపన్నుడై యుండి, మనము మన అపరాధములచేత చచ్చినవారమై యుండినప్పుడు సయితము మనయెడల చూపిన తన మహా  ప్రేమచేత మనలను క్రీసు కృపచేత మీరు రక్షింపబడియున్నారు.
bible_verses.english: But because of his great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy, made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in transgressions—it is by grace you have been saved.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for stepping into our darkness and rescuing us through the sacrifice of the cross. You have traded our fear for everlasting hope and brought our weary hearts back to life. As the great and mighty King, You reign with authority over every detail of my life. I bow before Your throne today in awe and love, lifting my voice to declare that You alone are holy.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for stepping into our darkness and rescuing us through the sacrifice of the cross. You have traded our fear for everlasting hope and brought our weary hearts back to life. As the great and mighty King, You reign with authority over every detail of my life. I bow before Your throne today in awe and love, lifting my voice to declare that You alone are holy.
devotional.reflection_english: We were once bound by fear, but Jesus rescued us through the cross and brought us into His living hope. He isn't just a distant ruler; He is our compassionate Savior who raises us from death to life and reigns with supreme majesty. As we gaze upon His holiness, our hearts naturally overflow with gratitude and praise. Today, let us step into the freedom He bought for us and join the heavenly song declaring His glory.
